entries.lean_target: theorem APEX.PXP.weighted_fourth_moment_certificate (n : ℕ) (d : FibCube n → ℝ) : Matrix.trace ((A n + Matrix.diagonal d)^4) = linearCertificate n d   -- certificate as defined in Thm 2.1, computed by an O(n) recursion

entries.statement: Prop. 1: detuning/calibration budget: ‖[U(T)-U0(T)]P‖ <= int_0^T e(t)dt =: eps_T, ‖QU(T)P‖^2 <= eps_T^2, ‖U_T - U_{0,T}‖_⋄ <= 2 eps_T.
entries.next_step: Time-independent (or piecewise-constant) case first: ‖e^{-iT(H0+E)} - e^{-iTH0}‖ <= T‖E‖ through the Duhamel integral (Mathlib NormedSpace.exp + HasDerivAt). Then use APEX-QI-1..4 to get diamondDist(U,U0) <= 2‖U-U0‖. The time-dependent version needs propagators of linear ODEs (Mathlib-level through Gronwall, but longer).
entries.lean_target: theorem APEX.Quantum.detuning_budget_const (H₀ E : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H₀.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : ‖exp (-(I*T) • (H₀+E)) - exp (-(I*T) • H₀)‖ ≤ T * ‖E‖ ∧ diamondDist (unitaryChannel (exp (-(I*T) • (H₀+E)))) (unitaryChannel (exp (-(I*T) • H₀))) ≤ 2 * T * ‖E‖
